headline: Palantine Berm Flares as Marban and Expanse Grind On
war_summary: Three hours on the wires show a sharp turn at Palantine Berm, now the liveliest sector with seven changes in two hours and sixteen in the day about the Pippeli Stones and the Droll, standing three Colonial, three Warden and one neutral with the latest entry at the cutoff. Marban Hollow has rekindled with five changes in two hours, thirteen in six, seventeen in the day centred on Checkpoint Bua, holding one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest ground with five changes in two hours and seventy-three in the day about Wightwalk and Frostmarch, now seven Warden and two neutral, while Mooring County has fallen silent in the last two hours after ten in six and forty-seven in the day about MacConmara Barrows and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now listed twelve Warden. Kuura Strand is likewise quiet after its earlier eight, Stlican Shelf posts three fresh changes and eighteen in the day about Breaker Town and Briar, and Nevish Line and Stonecradle add small late movements amid very heavy casualty returns at Callahan's Passage, Clahstra, Linn Mercy and Morgens Crossing without further flips.
